name: project-management
description: Pre-built Jira workflows for a Scrum team — status briefs, ticket triage, board cleanup, sprint close and planning, roadmap updates, and spec writing. You approve every step that touches the board.

interface.shortDescription: Jira workflows for Scrum teams — status briefs, triage, sprint planning, and more.
interface.longDescription: Pre-built project-management workflows for a Scrum team using Jira (via Atlassian). Routes open-ended requests to the right skill, pauses before every Jira change, and works standalone for planning and spec writing.
